paragraphs: Ravnai, brother of R' Hiyya bar Abba. Berakhot 21b; see above, Rav Huna bar Minyomi. ‘Thus Shmuel said’: Ketubbot 21, beginning of b. Ketubbot 50b calls him R' Banai, brother of R' Hiyya bar Abba. He was holding the orphans’ movable property, and they came before Shmuel.
